# hcloudplus_limits (Data Source)

Account-wide resource limits and usage. Reads GET /_user/limits. Useful for building capacity dashboards or Prometheus exporters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hcloudplus_limits" "account" {}

# Example: expose current usage + quota as outputs for a dashboard.
output "server_quota" {
  value = data.hcloudplus_limits.account.limits["server"]
}

output "primary_ip_quota" {
  value = data.hcloudplus_limits.account.limits["primary_ip"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `extended_support` (Boolean)
- `limits` (Attributes Map) Map of resource name (e.g. 'server', 'bucket') to {limit, usage}. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits))
- `request_allowed` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limits`

Read-Only:

- `limit` (Number)
- `usage` (Number)
